sign_up_offers.title: Welcome Offer
sign_up_offers.terms:
Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new-to-UOB credit card customers only.
Successfully apply to be the principal cardholder for select UOB Credit Cards within the promo period and spend a min. of S$1,000 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for 
S$100 Samsung Voucher
 reward.
Plus, receive a 10% discount when you use your UOB Credit Card on Samsung Singapore transactions via the Samsung online store with min. spend of S$1,000.
Samsung reserves the right to amend or withdraw the discount promotion without prior notice.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.

sign_up_offers.title: SingSaver Flash Deal
sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Flash Deal promotion is valid from 2 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new-to-UOB credit cardmembers only.
Be one of the first 2 applicants at 2 PM & 10PM every day during the flash deal period to apply for selected UOB credit cards and make a min. spend of S$500 within the first 30 days of card approval to be eligible for the Flash Deal reward:
S$200 Cash via PayNow
; or a
Samsonite Straren Spinner 67/24 (worth S$600)
.
Remaining applicants will receive 
S$90 Cash via PayNow
.
Promotion is stackable with UOB Welcome Offer (additional T&Cs apply).
Terms and Conditions
 apply

extra.description: The UOB EVOL Credit Card is a solid cashback card for online, mobile contactless and overseas spend, making it one of the best cashback cards for travel. It allows cardholders to earn up to 10% cashback with no FX fees and its annual fee will be waived with no minimum spend. A minimum monthly spend of S$800 is required to earn the 10% cashback, which is capped at S$80 per month. Pair it with the UOB One account to enjoy up to 3.4% p.a. interest on your savings.
